caseName: Nhuong Van Nguyen v. Superior Court of Cal.
caseNameFull: NHUONG VAN NGUYEN v. SUPERIOR COURT OF CALIFORNIA, RIVERSIDE COUNTY

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until October 24, 2016, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *27538(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
